description: Parse project.godot into JSON without launching Godot. Use to inspect display, input and rendering settings. Pass section for one INI section. Returns: settings as { [section]: { [key]: value } }, or { [key]: value } plus section. Strings are unescaped, an empty value is null, complex values stay raw text. Keys before any section are under __global__. warnings leads when the section is absent, a value is unterminated or empty, a line is not as Godot writes it, or a setting is assigned twice.

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

section.description: Filter to a specific INI section (e.g. "display", "application"). Omit for all sections; an empty string is treated as omitted.

name: get_project_settings

section.description: Present when a section filter was applied.

settings.description: Without section: { [section]: { [key]: value } }. With section: { [key]: value }. A value is a string, number, boolean or null (an empty value).

warnings.description: Present only when there is something to say. One entry names, by line number, every line that is not in the form Godot writes (two statements on a line, a statement after a header, a # line, a value that is not one whole value): the engine may read such a line differently from what settings shows.
